onboarding.appSub: ສູນພົນລະເມືອງລາວ
onboarding.issuedBy: Ministry of Home Affairs · Ministry of Public Security
onboarding.slide1Title: Every public service in one app
onboarding.slide1Desc: Residence certificates, birth and marriage registration, bills and taxes — reach dozens of government services without queuing at an office.
onboarding.slide2Desc: Submit from your phone and watch your application move from submitted to approved — with a clear reason whenever something needs fixing.
onboarding.slide3Desc: Approved certificates stay in your account. View, download or let an officer scan the verification code — whenever you need them.

tutorial.step1Desc: Your all-in-one platform for government public services — apply for certificates, track applications, and stay informed, all from your phone.
tutorial.step2Desc: Use the search bar at the top of the home screen to instantly find any service by name — no need to scroll through the list.
tutorial.step3Desc: Use the category tabs (Housing, Identity, Family, Documents) to narrow down the services, or view all at once.
tutorial.step4Desc: Tap any service card to see details: required documents, processing time, and fee. Then hit Apply Now to submit your request digitally.
tutorial.step5Desc: Go to the History tab to monitor all submitted applications — see their status (Pending, Approved, Rejected) in real time.
tutorial.step6Desc: Check the News tab for government announcements, and use the chat button (bottom-right) to reach our support team anytime.
tutorial.newsDesc: Government announced new digital ID framework
